definitions.explanation: Clothes and merchandise meant for the hot months — light fabrics, short sleeves, sandals. Mainly a retail and wardrobe word, used when shops change their stock over and when households swap seasonal clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧{夏物|なつもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}そう→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: It's about time to get the summer clothes out.

examples.japanese: ⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{夏物|なつもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The summer clothing sale has started at the department store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衣替|ころもが}え→衣替え：07709_koromogae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{冬物|ふゆもの}→冬物：27498_fuyumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しまい、{夏物|なつもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}した→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧。
examples.english: I changed over my wardrobe, putting away the winter things and taking out the summer ones.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夏物|なつもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧/しまう: to get out / put away summer clothes
- {夏物|なつもの}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: summer clothing sale
- {夏物|なつもの}⟦{衣料|いりょう}→衣料：02612_iryou⟧: summer apparel

SEASONAL SERIES:
The same ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ pattern names each season's goods:
- {春物|はるもの}: spring wear
- {秋物|あきもの}: autumn wear
- ⟦{冬物|ふゆもの}→冬物：27498_fuyumono⟧: winter wear

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{衣替|ころもが}え→衣替え：07709_koromogae⟧: the seasonal changeover of clothing, done around June 1 and October 1
